version.description: Select and record the exact upstream tag, release, commit, or dated distribution before import.

name.description: Record the exact reviewed OEWN source artifact file name before import.

url.description: Record the exact source artifact URL before import.

sha256.description: Compute the reviewed source artifact SHA-256 outside the repository before import.

bytes.description: Record the reviewed source artifact byte count outside the repository before import.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.attribution: Open English WordNet contributors, used under CC BY 4.0.

provenance.description: Rows generated from the future reviewed Open English WordNet source artifact after license, digest, import, evaluator, and benchmark gates pass.

importer.command: php language-fts-playground/tools/import-lexical-source.php wordnet-json "$OEWN_REVIEWED_SOURCE_ARTIFACT" "$LANGUAGE_FTS_OEWN_OUTPUT_DIR" --language=en --data-kind=imported_comprehensive --source-name="Open English WordNet" --source-url="$OEWN_EXACT_ARTIFACT_URL" --source-version="$OEWN_EXACT_VERSION" --source-retrieved-at="$OEWN_RETRIEVED_AT" --source-artifact-name="$OEWN_EXACT_ARTIFACT_NAME" --source-artifact-url="$OEWN_EXACT_ARTIFACT_URL" --source-artifact-sha256="$OEWN_EXACT_SHA256" --source-artifact-bytes="$OEWN_EXACT_BYTES" --license-name="Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International" --license-id=CC-BY-4.0 --license-url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ --license-text-url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt --license-text-file=LICENSE.oewn.txt --normalization-profile-version=language-fts-playground-normalization-v1 --attribution="Open English WordNet contributors, used under CC BY 4.0." --pack-version="$OEWN_PACK_VERSION" --pack-date="$OEWN_PACK_DATE" --provenance=oewn-comprehensive-reviewed --command-artifact-label=oewn-reviewed-source-artifact

real_import_blockers: Fill source.version, source.artifact.name, source.artifact.url, source.artifact.sha256, and source.artifact.bytes from a reviewed OEWN artifact.
Preserve the redistributable license notice text as LICENSE.oewn.txt in the generated runtime pack.
Run a deterministic import twice and compare generated runtime outputs and pack.lock.json byte for byte.
Run lexical validation, relevance evaluation, fanout cap checks, and benchmark budget checks on the generated runtime pack.
